Overview Summary: Nicole set up your 17hats account in June 2026 with workflows for Theatre, Event, and Headshot photography.
Quick Tip 1: Theatre and Event projects both lead to the ~Theatre/Events Gallery Delivered workflow at the end
Quick Tip 2: To add a client's gallery link to their project (and for automated emails), click the small pencil button on the right side of the project screen to edit, then find the field for the link and paste it in

Pipelines give the bird's eye view of all leads and clients (navigate between pipelines top right). When entering a project, check 'What's coming up in the next 7 days' first, then click into the workflow to see completed and upcoming steps.
